mechanism_relevant_findings: The hydrogel electrolyte maintains exceptional ionic conductivity due to the establishment of continuous Zn2+ ion conduction pathways.
The unique structure of the hydrogel significantly suppresses ice crystallization and depresses the freezing point.
limitations: Achieving high mechanical strength, low frost resistance temperature, and superior ionic conductivity concurrently remains challenging.

relevance_judgement.reason: The study presents significant advancements in proton conduction mechanisms in hydrogel electrolytes at ultra-low temperatures.
